_comment: WORKER KEYS USB = KEYS ONLY. No users.json, no headscale/vault/gitops/storage/backup service config — those live ONLY on the pki node's USB + JSON config. A worker carries just: the cluster-join token + CA (kubernetes.*), the mesh authkey (tailscale), the cluster CA cert (files), and break-glass SSH keys (ssh/root.authorized_keys). It joins the pki control-plane and gets all service config + secrets from there (ArgoCD + Vault/ESO).
_comment_nodes: Reach the pki control-plane + mesh + binhost by IP (written to /etc/hosts), so tailscale login_server and kubeadm api_server resolve before DNS exists.
